reviewScope: Eight selected cohort2 claims only; not full chapter/date approval
sharedReasoning: All 78 supplied Chinese units were read. Ancient military exempla in s0511, s0515–0518, s0523 and the Lu ritual precedent in s0540 do not date the contemporary campaign. The renewed dispatch, current siege, report to Jilong and subsequent Xie Ai counterattack are continuous narrative following Chonghua’s s0499 accession. Their exact year is not restated, but a lower bound from that accession is supported. No specific later Yonghe year, year of death for Shi Hu, lifespan interval or upper endpoint can be inferred from this packet.

judgments.sourceReason: s0549 季龍復遣 attributes the reinforcement dispatch to Jilong; s0559 季龍聞而歎 attributes the subsequent reaction to the same current ruler. These are Shi Hu’s own actions. The s0599 retrospective death mentioned only in the unresolvedReason is not required for, and supplies no endpoint to, this claim.
